convert_gguf_endian: convert a GGUF model file from one byte order to another using the gguf_convert_endian script
run_gguf_byteswap_dry_run: run a dry run of gguf_convert_endian to check tensor compatibility without modifying the file
convert_gguf_to_native_endian: convert a GGUF file to native host byte order for immediate loading on the current machine
convert_gguf_to_big_endian: convert a GGUF file to big-endian byte order for cross-platform compatibility
convert_gguf_to_little_endian: convert a GGUF file to little-endian byte order for x86/arm platform compatibility
